data.name: ConfigKeys_Theme
data.value: Colors for a dark or light terminal background: auto (COLORFGBG, else dark), dark or light

data.name: ConfigFile_InvalidKey
data.value: Invalid key '{key}': use dotted names such as ui.theme.

data.name: ConfigFile_NotAnObject
data.value: {path} does not hold a JSON object.

data.name: ConfigKeys_Protect
data.value: Namespaces where retry, delete, purge and send need --confirm with the namespace's name: comma-separated names or patterns (* and ?)

data.name: ConfigKeys_RedactNamespaces
data.value: Namespaces whose message bodies peek redacts, with no flag to turn it off: comma-separated names or patterns (* and ?)

data.name: ConfigKeys_RedactFields
data.value: JSON fields peek redacts in those namespaces, comma-separated: name, identifier.value, value* (wildcards), title:scalar (only text and numbers); also application property names. A body that isn't JSON is withheld

data.name: ConfigKeys_AzureAuth
data.value: How to sign in to Azure: cli (az login), browser (a browser window each run) or default (environment variables, managed identity, then developer tools)

data.name: ConfigKeys_AzureTransport
data.value: How messages reach Azure: tcp (AMQP, port 5671) or websockets (port 443, for networks that block 5671)
